name: 80220 · Denver, CO
findings: ZIP 80220 (Denver) has 153 nonprofit organizations. 73 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80220 (Denver) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 80220 (Denver) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 51 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.
